clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, a potent brew draws raised eyebrows as you carry it west. Tavernkeep Smitts entrusts you with Zombie Juice for Abercrombie, a reclusive hermit on Duskwood’s western edge. The drink is meant to warm the shivering old man, but its uncanny potency raises questions.

Tavernkeep Smitts of Darkshire brews a legendary draught called Zombie Juice. When it is ready, he hands you the bottle and warns you to handle it gently, saying the concoction is stout enough to raise the dead. You carry the potent drink across a haunted forest to an eccentric loner, on what seems like a simple act of charity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: ...and be careful with this stuff. It's strong enough to raise the dead!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights. Did you get it for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A thousand thanks, friend. You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!
Here you are, friend. Take this as a token of my gratitude.
